[[File:Mixed hide legs detail.png|100px|left]]
'''Mixed hide legs''' are part of the [[mixed hide armour]] set, requiring level 60 [[Ranged]] to wear. It provides bonuses that are meant to complement the [[hunter's spear]]. However, because of the added stab bonus, this item may be preferable to the [[Bandos tassets]] in situations where the additional 2 Strength bonus does not grant a max hit.

Players with level 71 [[Crafting]] can create the legs with a [[mixed hide base]] and three [[fox fur]]s, alongside a [[needle]] and [[thread]] (or a [[costume needle]]). Players without the required level may instead pay 20,000 [[coins]] to [[Pellem]] at the [[Hunter Guild]] to make one on their behalf, whilst providing the aforementioned fur (you do not need to provide the mixed hide base).
